exposure: MSAF diagnosed during the first stage of labor
abnormal fetal heart rate tracing pattern
cohort: 515 newborns born through meconium-stained amniotic fluid (MSAF)
finding: In case of MSAF, fetal scalp blood sampling did not reduce the risk of RDS.
mod_finding: This study investigated the impact of fetal scalp blood sampling on neonatal respiratory distress syndrome in cases of meconium-stained amniotic fluid but does not directly compare different modes of delivery.
